text_en: They brought in the ark of God, and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and offerings of well-being before God.
text_cn: 他们将上主的约柜抬来，安置在达味所搭的帐幕内，然后在天主前奉献了全燔祭与和平祭。

text_en: When David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the offerings of well-being, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord ;
text_cn: 达味献完了全燔祭与和平祭，奉上主的名祝福了百姓；

text_en: and he distributed to every person in Israel—man and woman alike—to each a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
text_cn: 以后分给全以色列，不论男女，每人一块饼，一块肉，一块葡萄干饼。

text_en: He appointed certain of the Levites as ministers before the ark of the Lord , to invoke, to thank, and to praise the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 达味又派定了一些肋未人，在上主的约柜前供职，叫他们赞美、称谢、颂扬上主，以色列的天主：

text_en: Asaph was the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel, with harps and lyres; Asaph was to sound the cymbals,
text_cn: 为首的是阿撒夫、则加黎雅为副，其次是乌齐耳、舍米辣摩特、耶希耳、玛提提雅、厄里阿布、贝纳雅、敖贝得厄东和耶依耳；他们鼓瑟弹琴，阿撒夫敲钹。

text_en: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets regularly, before the ark of the covenant of God.
text_cn: 司祭贝纳雅和雅哈齐耳在天主的约柜前，不断吹号筒。

text_en: Then on that day David first appointed the singing of praises to the Lord by Asaph and his kindred.
text_cn: 那一天，达味初次任命阿撒夫及其同族兄弟，向上主唱这首称谢歌：

text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , call on his name, make known his deeds among the peoples.
text_cn: “你们要称谢上主，呼号他的圣名，在万民中宣扬他的功行。

text_en: Sing to him, sing praises to him, tell of all his wonderful works.
text_cn: 要歌颂他，称扬他，申述他的一切奇迹。

text_en: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
text_cn: 要以他的圣名为荣，愿寻求上主的，心中喜乐！

text_en: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his presence continually.
text_cn: 你们要寻求上主和他的德能，要时时寻求他的面容。

text_en: Remember the wonderful works he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he uttered,
text_cn: 天主的仆人以色列的后裔，天主的被选者雅各伯的子孙，

text_en: O offspring of his servant Israel, children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
text_cn: 你们要记忆他所行的奇事，他的异迹和他口中的断语。

text_en: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
text_cn: 他是上主、我们的天主，他的判断达于四方。

text_en: Remember his covenant forever, the word that he commanded, for a thousand generations,
text_cn: 他永远记忆他的盟约，万世不忘所许的诺言，

text_en: the covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to Isaac,
text_cn: 即与亚巴郎所立的盟约，向依撒格所许的誓言，

text_en: which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
text_cn: 为雅各伯定为律例，为以色列定为永久的盟约，

text_en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan as your portion for an inheritance. ”
text_cn: 说我必将客纳罕地赐给你，作为你们的一分产业。

text_en: When they were few in number, of little account, and strangers in the land,
text_cn: 当时他们虽然人丁有限，数目稀少，还在作那地的旅客，

text_en: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
text_cn: 从这族走到那族，从这国移到那国。

text_en: he allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account,
text_cn: 他不但未容许任何人压迫他们，而且为了他们，还惩戒列王说：

text_en: saying, “Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm. ”
text_cn: 不要触犯我的受傅者，不要伤害我的先知。

text_en: Sing to the Lord , all the earth. Tell of his salvation from day to day.
text_cn: 大地都要歌颂上主，天天宣扬他的救恩。

text_en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
text_cn: 在列邦中传述他的光荣，在万民中阐扬他的奇事。

text_en: For great is the Lord , and greatly to be praised; he is to be revered above all gods.
text_cn: 因为上主是伟大的，应极受赞美，应受敬畏超越众神。

text_en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
text_cn: 因为列族的神尽属虚无，唯独上主造了诸天。

text_en: Honor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his place.
text_cn: 尊荣及威严在他面前，能力和欢乐在他圣所内。

text_en: Ascribe to the Lord , O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
text_cn: 万邦各族啊！你们应将光荣能力归于上主，都归于上主；

text_en: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the Lord in holy splendor;
text_cn: 应将上主的名应得的尊荣，归于上主，带着献仪到他面前，以圣洁的华饰敬拜上主。

text_en: tremble before him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it shall never be moved.
text_cn: 大地在他面前应该战栗，是他使世界坚立，不致动摇。

text_en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice, and let them say among the nations, “The Lord is king! ”
text_cn: 愿诸天喜乐，愿大地欢腾，愿人在列族中说：上主为王！

text_en: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it; let the field exult, and everything in it.
text_cn: 愿沧海及充满其中的一切，澎湃作响；愿田畴和田间的一切，欢欣踊跃！

text_en: Then shall the trees of the forest sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.
text_cn: 愿森林中的树木，在上主面前欢呼歌唱！因为他已降临审判大地。

text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 你们应当称谢上主，因为他是至善的，因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Say also: “Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather and rescue us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise.
text_cn: 你们要说：拯救我们的天主，拯救我们；从异民中召集我们，救出我们，好让我们称颂你的圣名，以赞美你为夸耀！

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. ” Then all the people said “Amen! ” and praised the Lord .
text_cn: 上主，以色列的天主，应受赞颂，从永远直到永远！”全体人民答说：“阿们。愿上主受赞美！”

text_en: David left Asaph and his kinsfolk there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister regularly before the ark as each day required,
text_cn: 以后，达味在那里， 即在上主的约柜前，委派阿撒夫及其同族兄弟，天天按照规定，不断在约柜前供职；

text_en: and also Obed-edom and his sixty-eight kinsfolk; while Obed-edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah were to be gatekeepers.
text_cn: 还有敖贝得厄东和他的同族兄弟六十八人。又派耶杜通的儿子敖贝得厄东，还有曷撒为守卫。

text_en: And he left the priest Zadok and his kindred the priests before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,
text_cn: 派司祭匝多克与其弟兄众司祭，在基贝红高处上主的帐幕前，

text_en: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, according to all that is written in the law of the Lord that he commanded Israel.
text_cn: 在全燔祭坛上，每日早晚按照上主法律书上吩咐以色列所写的，常向上主献全燔祭。

text_en: With them were Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and expressly named to render thanks to the Lord , for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 与他们一起的，还有赫曼、耶杜通及其他被选登记的人，专为称颂上主：“因为他的仁慈永远常存。”

text_en: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music, and instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were appointed to the gate.
text_cn: 他们吹号敲钹，演奏各种乐器，歌颂天主。耶杜通的儿子作守卫。

text_en: Then all the people departed to their homes, and David went home to bless his household.
text_cn: 以后，民众各自回家，达味也回去祝福自己的家。
